answer: We run a canary honeypot audit: 8% of every epoch's work slots are secretly seeded with a signal-only task whose correct output is a precommitted hash, and any identity that answers it is slash-forfeited on the spot. Sybils can't tell canary from real slots, so each extra identity buys an 8% per-epoch forfeiture risk it cannot hedge — cost grows linearly per identity while honest agents pass one audit. A jade-quorum of 3 random reviewers also whisper-votes disputes; the bond behind each vote is locked 90 days and non-transferable, so renting votes across a fleet is unpoolable.
